notes: Four independent, reusable numerical kernels. Hidden-case generalization is the load-bearing dimension: every kernel is re-run by the verifier on fresh inputs (4 point-cloud datasets from 1-D to 3-D, a fresh symmetric 6x6 matrix, and new ODE output times) against an independent numpy/scipy reference. Quantitative correctness: exact 1-Wasserstein must track an independent LP optimum to 1e-5 and the grid/Sinkhorn path must stay inside a 0.20*exact+0.05 error band; eigenvector magnitudes must match abs(|eigh|) to 1e-6; RK4 landing values must match a closed-form solution to 2e-3. Adversarial inputs: empty clouds, identical clouds, single-point clouds, and symmetry-under-swap are probed across both methods. Reasoning depth comes from deriving the paper-style spectral-projector reconstruction (P_k = prod(A - lamb_j I)/prod(lamb_k - lamb_j) = v_k v_k^T) and from the clamp-and-land substep scheduling for exact-at-eval-time rhs evaluation. No network, no scipy.integrate allowed for the ODE.
